resources.string: "Add a home screen icon with your remaining quota. Tap it to open Quodex. The percentage follows quota updates; background updates depend on system scheduling."
"After setup, return to the app and refresh once, then check the widget\'s update time. The target interval is not an exact schedule; sleep or lost connectivity can still delay updates."
"Alerts when a compatible Quodex update is available"
"Allow activity: In manual management, enable autostart and background activity. Configure secondary launch permissions only if needed by your system."
"Allow autostart: Settings → Apps and permissions → Permission management → Permissions → Autostart, then enable Quodex."
"Allow autostart: Settings → Apps → Manage apps / Permissions → Autostart / Background autostart, then enable Quodex. You can also search Settings for “autostart”."
"Allow background activity: App info → App battery usage / Battery → Allow background usage. If updates are still restricted, choose Unrestricted."
"Allow background activity: App info → Battery. Select Unrestricted if available."
"Allow background activity: App info → Battery usage / Power management. Enable background activity and autostart if available. Menus differ across ColorOS, OxygenOS, and realme UI versions."
"Allow background activity: Settings → Battery → Background power usage / High background power usage. Find Quodex and allow it to run in the background."
"Allow startup: Search Settings for “autostart” or “app launch management” and enable Quodex if the option is available."
"Android will ask you to confirm the update. App data will be kept. You may first need to allow Quodex to install apps."
"Authorization timed out. Get a new sign-in code."
"Autostart and locking: Stock Android usually has no separate autostart switch or background lock. On other brands, search Settings for “autostart” or “run in background” and adjust Quodex only."
"Background updates may be delayed; refresh manually at any time"
"Battery and network conditions may delay background updates. After persistent failures, each round makes at most 3 attempts, then waits for the next interval or a manual refresh."
"Battery saving or lost connectivity may delay updates."
"Check available storage or the sharing app, then try again."
"Check network access: App info → Mobile data → Allow background data. Allow unrestricted data in Data Saver if needed."
"Checks GitHub releases and prereleases about every 12 hours, and alerts you once for each newer compatible version. System scheduling, battery saving, or lost connectivity may delay checks."
"Choose a layout and add it to your home screen."
"Compact and wide layouts that adapt to your home screen"
"Complete device sign-in on OpenAI\'s website. Do not enter your account password in Quodex."
"Confirm adding the icon in the home screen prompt."
"Connect an account to see your actual quota here."
"Connect your existing account to view subscription quota. Credentials are encrypted on this device; quota is fetched directly from OpenAI."
"Could not check for updates. Check your network or try again later."
"Could not open notification settings. Open Quodex in your device settings."
"Could not open permission settings. Allow Quodex to install apps in system settings, then try again."
"Could not open system settings. Search Settings for Quodex app info."
"Could not open the system installer. Try again later."
"Could not read secure credentials. Reconnect your account."
"Could not read the APK. Download it again."
"Could not save the APK. Check available storage."
"Debug build · Only checks updates with the same signature"
"Device sign-in and quota access use experimental compatibility interfaces. Credentials are encrypted locally. The app does not make model requests or use reset credits."
"Download in the app, then follow Android\'s installation prompts."
"Download incomplete. Check your network and storage, then try again."
"Exclude from sleep: Settings → Battery / Device care → Background usage limits. Remove Quodex from sleeping and deep sleeping apps, and add it to “Never sleeping apps”."
"First enable device code sign-in in ChatGPT security settings. Workspace accounts may need an administrator to enable it."
"If installation was not completed, tap Install again."
"If you used Force stop in App info, reopen Quodex to resume scheduling. Background locking cannot override Force stop."
"Installation is not yet allowed. Tap Install to grant permission again. The downloaded APK will be kept."
"Keep in background: Open recent apps, press and hold the Quodex card, and select the lock icon. Some versions use Security → Settings → Boost speed → Lock apps. This reduces removal by “clear all”."
"Keep in background: Open the Quodex card menu in recent apps, or press and hold the card, and enable Lock if available. Older versions may use a downward swipe."
"Keep in background: Open the Quodex card menu in recent apps and enable Lock if available to prevent removal by one-tap cleanup."
"Keep in background: Swipe down on the Quodex card in recent apps or open its menu, then lock it if a lock option exists. Applies only to Android-compatible systems that can install this app."
"Layout preview · Sample data, not your quota"

"Local credentials, quota cache, and background quota tasks will be removed. Widgets will show a disconnected state. Display and app update preferences are kept. This does not revoke remote authorization."
"Main quota and update time in less space."
"Manage startup manually: Search Settings for “app launch management” and turn off automatic management for Quodex."
"Missing data does not mean no usage. Token counts are never estimated from quota percentages."
"Network connection failed. Previous data has been kept."
"Network connection failed. Token statistics could not be updated."
"No displayable daily usage records were returned."
"No period quota was provided, so no percentage is shown. Usage still depends on your account\'s entitlements."
"Not connected. Tap to connect an account."
"Notifications are disabled. Updates are still visible in the app."
"Press and hold an empty area of the home screen → Widgets → Quodex → %1$s."
"Press and hold on your home screen to resize. Background updates may be delayed; the last update time is always visible."
"Quodex %1$s\nIndependent third-party tool · Experimental connectivity\nThe app only reads quota and usage statistics; sign-in credentials may grant broader access."
"Quota and reset times, adapted to the widget size."
"Quota format not yet supported. Check for an update."
"Recent apps: Enable “Keep open” if the card menu offers it. This option is not available on all devices and does not grant autostart permission."
"Refresh manually from the top-right corner. Failed updates keep the last successful data. Refresh to confirm quota after its reset time."
"Relax battery restrictions: App info → Battery saver / Battery → No restrictions."
"See your remaining Codex quota and reset times on your Android home screen."
"Selected for your device brand; you can change it. Menus vary by version and region. Use Settings search if you cannot find an option."
"Service data may be incomplete. Only available statistics are shown."
"Service temporarily unavailable. Previous data has been kept."
"Statistics may be delayed. This interface does not separate input, output, or cached tokens."
"Tap to download and install the update in the app"
"Target background interval: %1$s minutes. Battery settings and network conditions may delay updates."
"The APK does not match this app or the target version. Check for updates again."
"The APK has been downloaded and verified."
"The APK is no longer valid. Download it again."
"The APK signature does not match. It cannot update this installation."
"The APK size does not match. Download it again."
"The device keeps the latest 200 events and 7 days of hourly statistics. Nothing is uploaded automatically. After reproducing an issue, you can preview and share the report with the maintainer."
"The download address is invalid. Check for updates again."
"The home screen icon could not be updated. Try again."
"The layout adapts to home screen size and font settings. Press and hold a widget to resize or configure it."
"The operation could not be completed. Try again; if it keeps failing, check your device storage."
"The service currently does not allow Codex use. Check your account\'s actual entitlements and limits."
"The service has not provided daily token data yet."
"The service has not provided valid usage data yet. Refresh later."
"The token statistics format is not supported yet. Check for an app update."
"The token statistics service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later."
"These settings apply to this widget only. Changing “Show remaining quota” in the app updates all widgets, while keeping each widget\'s theme."
"This account cannot access token statistics right now."
"This account did not provide hourly quota. The available longer-period quota is still shown."
"This account did not return period-based quota. Check your account\'s actual entitlements."
"This account or workspace does not currently allow access."
"This is a debug build and only checks updates with the same signature. Install an official release to receive updates from the release channel."
"This is a preview, not your actual quota. Demo mode does not request account quota."
"This release has no APK checksum. Check for updates again later."

"This status only reflects Android battery optimization. Manufacturer autostart and background lock settings must be checked in system settings. Allowing background activity may increase battery use."
"Token statistics authorization is unavailable. Refresh or reconnect."
"Token statistics could not be saved. Check device storage."
"Too many token statistics requests. Try again later."
"Updates stop after clearing recent apps? Check your device\'s autostart, battery, and background lock settings."
"Valid APK details are missing. Check for updates again."
"%1$s days recorded as 0. Open daily details for exact values."
"%1$s. The preview retains the last successful data."
"%1$s — %2$s\nDates come from the service and are not converted to the device time zone."
"Version details have changed. Check for updates again."
"When disconnected, home screen widgets prompt you to connect an account."
"You can close this dialog and check progress from the update entry later."
"Your launcher did not accept direct adding. Select the widget manually."
"Your launcher does not support this icon. You can use a widget instead."
Applies to the app, widgets, and update notifications.
"See remaining Codex quota, reset times, and the last update on your home screen."
"Compact 2×1 widget with your main quota or account status and last update time."
"On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, both quota icons and in-app widget adding need the Home screen shortcuts permission. If it is denied, tapping Add may do nothing."
"In Quodex app info, open Permissions → Other permissions → Home screen shortcuts → Always allow. Menu names may vary by system version."
"After enabling it, return here and tap Continue adding. If it is already allowed, you can continue now."
"Color intensity is relative to the peak day in this period."
"One square per service date. Gray = recorded as 0; outlined = no data. Tap a square or open daily details."
"Token heatmap, %1$s to %2$s, %3$s tokens, %4$s days with records. %5$s"
"Missing data is never estimated from quota percentages."
"Thirty service dates in a GitHub-style heatmap. Resizable 4×3 widget with refresh; tap the chart to open the 30-day view."
"The server asked us to wait. Please try again later."
